name: issue-assistant
description: Reconcile Linear or GitHub issues with source-backed evidence, safely recover planned changes, and resolve one issue decision at a time.

interface.longDescription: Audit merged PRs and project context, maintain a source-backed backlog, and work directly on a named issue or the next actionable priority. Includes verifiable subtasks, explicit preview mode, recoverable change plans, offline coverage checks, and a separately invoked unattended reconciliation skill.
defaultPrompt: Reconcile the last 28 days of merged PRs with my issues, apply evidence-backed updates, then grill me on the highest-priority actionable issue, one question at a time.
Find missing issues, stale completion states, and changed requirements in my Linear or GitHub backlog.
Break this issue into independently verifiable subtasks and identify the first task to implement.
